title: A '$' in a BLOCKED question's shell command classifies it as Spending money
body:
standing_orders.go's money class lists "$" as a subject, and containsWord matches a punctuation-only phrase anywhere. yck's ceiling BLOCKED question quoted `sed -n '/^# Named run configs/,$p' ...`, so the hold was recorded under class 'Spending money'. The outcome (hold for a person) was right for another reason (the deliverable was outside the worker boundary), but any question quoting a shell command, regex or $VAR holds as a money question and tells the person the wrong thing. Match '$' only beside a digit (\$\d) or drop it.
evidence: internal/reconcile/standing_orders.go:143 ("$" in the money subjects) and containsWord's punctuation-only branch; .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/decisions/6.json response.class "Spending money"
